# Promptly — AI Prompt Marketplace

Promptly is a marketplace where AI creators publish ready-to-use prompts across finance, law, marketing, writing, design, and more. AI agents can browse, preview, buy, and publish prompts programmatically via REST API or MCP.

Full prompt text is gated until purchase (or you are the author). List and detail REST responses return a short preview for anonymous/unpurchased callers.

## MCP Server (recommended for agents)
Endpoint: POST /api/mcp
Discovery: GET /api/mcp  or  GET /.well-known/mcp.json
Protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0, HTTP stateless transport
Auth: Authorization: Bearer sk_...  (or ?key=sk_...)

GET /api/mcp is discovery only. Tool calls use POST.

Buy tools unlock other creators' prompts. Publish tools exist (`create_prompt`, `create_prompts_bulk`, …) but publishing is invite-only — not a public free-for-all. An API key is required and does not grant open publishing.

### Browse (no auth) — metadata + preview only
  list_categories, list_tags, list_authors, get_author
  search_prompts, get_prompt, get_similar, get_prompt_stats, list_reviews

### Utilities (no auth)
  validate_prompt, extract_variables

### Buy (API key) — spend credits, retrieve full text
  get_balance, purchase_prompt, list_purchased, get_earnings, list_transactions

### Publish (API key, invite-only)
  whoami, create_category, list_my_prompts, create_prompt, create_prompts_bulk
  update_prompt, delete_prompt, fork_prompt

### Collect (API key)
  save_prompt, unsave_prompt, list_saved
  create_collection, add_to_collection, list_collections

### Evaluate (API key)
  create_review

## REST API
  GET  /api/prompts                   List prompts — `content` is a preview unless purchased
  GET  /api/prompts/:id               Prompt details — preview unless purchased / author
  GET  /api/prompts/:id/content       Full text — requires purchase or ownership
  GET  /api/categories                List categories (no auth)
  GET  /api/mcp                       MCP discovery (POST for JSON-RPC)
  GET  /api/agent/balance             Credits remaining (bearer auth)
  POST /api/agent/purchase            { promptId } — buy with credits (bearer auth)
  GET  /api/agent/purchased           Purchase history (bearer auth)

## Authentication
Generate an API key at: /settings → API Keys tab
Use as: Authorization: Bearer sk_...

## Pricing model
- Browse and preview: free, no account needed
- Individual prompts: typically $5 USD
- Credits are pre-loaded to your API key and deducted per purchase
- If you already purchased a prompt, re-fetching it is always free

## Categories available
finance, law, technology, writing, marketing, data-analytics, design, research, business, education

## About the content
Prompts are written by human creators — individuals and firms specializing in their domain. Each prompt includes a title, description, tags, and the full prompt text (unlocked after purchase).
